tools.name: get-calculator
tools.description: Get an isbul.net Turkish payroll/severance/tax calculator: its purpose, page URL and the inputs it needs (e.g. "maas-hesaplama", "tazminat-hesaplama", "gelir-vergisi-hesaplama"). Omit calculatorSlug to list every available calculator.

calculatorSlug.description: Calculator slug (e.g. "maas-hesaplama"). Leave empty to list all calculators.

tools.name: get-job-detail
tools.description: Fetch the full detail of a single isbul.net job listing — description, company, location, salary, requirements and application URL.

jobId.description: The job id or slug returned by search-jobs (e.g. "senior-yazilim-gelistirici-istanbul-123456").

tools.name: search-companies
tools.description: Search employer company profiles (firma pages) on isbul.net. Returns company name and profile URL.

tools.name: search-jobs
tools.description: Search active job listings on isbul.net, Turkey's leading job board. Returns matching jobs with title, company, city, salary and a direct URL.

query.description: Search keyword in Turkish or English (e.g. "yazılım geliştirici", "muhasebe", "sales manager").

city.description: City name or slug to filter by (e.g. "istanbul", "ankara", "izmir").
